title: distephanus bakeri
intro: Distephanus bakeri, commonly known as Bakers' Bush or Sweet Bush, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Distephanus bakeri are attributed to its ability to act as a demulcent, soothing irritated tissues and mucous membranes, and as a diuretic, promoting the elimination of excess fluids. The bioactive constituents of the plant include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
